title: dactylorhiza hatagirea
intro: Dactylorhiza hatagirea, commonly known as the Kashmir orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid belonging to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza hatagirea are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever, treating respiratory issues, and alleviating digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
